title: Appointment booked confirmation
description: Confirm a new clinic booking with the doctor, date and location. Booking confirmation WhatsApp template for healthcare providers.
notes: Include how to cancel; patients expect it, and clear transactional intent helps utility approval.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, your appointment with {{doctor}} is booked for {{date}} at {{time}} at {{clinic}}. We'll send a reminder the day before.
